nodes.long_description:
Pull up a chair in your own 80s/90s bedroom. The CRT glows and the tools are waiting. RetroGameDev VR is a standalone Meta Quest app - half time machine, half hands-on workshop: learn how retro hardware works, create your own games, and export to real machines.

**Learn**

Built-in lessons open up the graphics, sound, and inner workings of real retro hardware.

**Create and Remix**

Start from a template game and make it your own. Use the built-in editors to redraw sprites, repaint palettes, design backgrounds, and compose sounds and music.

**Play Your Creations**

Run them on any of the bedroom's three displays - the desk monitor up close, the big-screen TV across the room, or the handheld you pick up and hold.

**Mixed Reality**

Flip to Mixed Reality and the bedroom drops to passthrough. Play on either TV model or the handheld, flatten or curve the screen, resize, and dim behind.

**Export to Real Hardware**

This is where it leaves the app behind. Turn your creation into a working cartridge that boots on genuine retro machines - real hardware, not emulation.

**Also Included**

Grab a light gun and take aim. A 3D gun model appears in your hand for point-and-shoot support across a range of retro systems, just like the arcade.
Watch your own video files on the bedroom screens in glorious retro style.

**Emulator Cores**

Free cores for multiple systems can be downloaded in-app (online needed once). No cores or games are bundled. You create or load your own game files, and you're responsible for having the right to use them.
nodes.short_description: Step into an 80s/90s bedroom and discover how classic game machines really work. Learn the hardware from the inside, create and remix your own retro games with built-in editors, and play your creations right there in the room - or flip to Mixed Reality and play them in your own space. Then export your game as a real ROM that runs on genuine retro hardware. Grab a light gun for arcade shooting. Half time machine, half hands-on game-making workshop - a standalone Meta Quest app, no PC needed.

nodes.long_description:
Pull up a chair in your own 80s/90s bedroom. The CRT glows, the posters are up, and the tools are waiting. RetroGameDev VR is part time machine, part hands-on workshop: learn how retro hardware really works, create games of your own, and play your creations across the room.

**Learn**

Built-in lessons open up the graphics, sound, and inner workings of real retro hardware, showing you how these classic machines tick from the inside.

**Create and Remix**

Start from a template game and make it your own. Use the built-in editors to redraw sprites, repaint palettes, design backgrounds, and compose your own sounds and music.

**Play Your Creations**

Play the games you make right there in the bedroom. Optional emulator cores can be downloaded in-app if you also want to load your own game files.

**Export to Real Hardware**

Turn your creation into a working cartridge that boots on genuine retro machines, not just inside the app.

**Also Included**

Watch your own video files on any of the three bedroom screens in glorious retro style.

**Emulator Cores**

Free cores for Game Boy / Game Boy Color / Game Boy Advance, NES, and Commodore 64 can be downloaded in-app. No cores or games are bundled. You create your own or load your own game files, and you are responsible for having the right to use any files you load.
nodes.short_description: Step into an 80s/90s bedroom and discover how classic game machines really work. Learn the hardware from the inside, create and remix your own retro games in built-in editors, and play your creations right there in the room. Then export your game as a real ROM that runs on genuine retro hardware. Part time machine, part hands-on game-making workshop.
